messages.subject: boxplot + jitter + outlier label
parts:
Hi,

I have recently started using ggplot and become a fan of it. I am able
to use documentation to find my out of most of the stuff but not able
to figure out how to put label on outliers. I have a very simple
data.

X, Y
A, 0.9
B, 0.8
C, 0.5
D, 0.1

In order to use geom_boxplot(), I created a dummy column and set all
the values to "dummy". So my final data looks like this
X, Y, dummy
A, 0.9, dummy
B, 0.8, dummy
C, 0.5, dummy
D, 0.1, dummy

and using this function to get the boxplot
ggplot() + geom_jitter(aes(x=dummy, y=y),data=data) +
geom_boxplot(aes(x=dummy, y=y),data=data)

Now I want to add labels (X) to the outliers. Can someone help me with
that.
